title.en: Between the crowd and the spring light

subtitle.zh: 两天，两种完全不同的画面
subtitle.en: Two days, two very different kinds of pictures

paragraphs.zh: 这趟台州，是为凤凰传奇的演唱会来的。4 月 12 日晚上看演出，第二天顺便去国清寺，原本很简单的安排，在照片里留下了两种完全不同的画面：一边是红色舞台、满场荧光棒，一边是田地、溪水和黄墙。把两天连起来看，热闹和春光之间，还夹着合影、夜宵和一杯咖啡。
paragraphs.en: I came to Taizhou for the Phoenix Legend concert. The plan was simple: the show on the evening of 12 April, then a visit to Guoqing Temple the next day. The photos ended up holding two very different scenes: a red stage and an arena full of glow sticks, then fields, streams and yellow walls. Between the crowd and the spring light were photos of us together, a late-night meal and a cup of coffee.

body.zh: 46 张照片按 23 组双图呈现，封面复用其中的舞台照。正文使用同组等比例、居中对称的裁剪预览图，点击可查看完整照片。配对按同一天的主题安排，不表示同时拍摄，也不完全按拍摄时刻排列。图注末尾是各自拍摄时刻，两天的行程先后以正文路线为准；照片时间不代表活动起止时间。
body.en: The 46 photos appear in 23 pairs, with one stage photo reused on the cover. Each pair uses matching frames with centered, symmetrically cropped previews; click to view the full photo. Pairs follow themes within the same day, not simultaneous moments or strict capture-time order. Each caption ends with its photo's capture time. The routes in the text give the day's sequence; photo times do not establish when activities began or ended.

paragraphs.zh: 下午在车站里，就看到了凤凰传奇「吉祥如意」台州站的大幅海报。这一趟的主题，还没到演出现场就已经迎面而来。
paragraphs.en: At the station that afternoon, I saw a large poster for Phoenix Legend's Jixiang Ruyi concert in Taizhou. The reason for the trip was right there before we had even reached the venue.

paragraphs.zh: 这次住的是台州希尔顿，就是离体育馆很近的那一家。到酒店后，我拍了房间和窗外的街景，也在健身房里留下了一张两人合影。那时窗外还是阴天，楼群和路口都罩着一层灰色。傍晚去体育场的路上，沿途拍到了商场外的红色大熊，镜头才渐渐从城市街景转向演唱会。
paragraphs.en: We stayed at Hilton Taizhou, the one near the stadium. After arriving, I photographed the room and the streets outside, and we took a photo together in the gym. It was still overcast, with a grey cast over the buildings and junctions. On the way to the stadium that evening, I also photographed a large red bear outside a shopping mall. Gradually, the camera turned from city streets to the concert.

subtitle.zh: 4 月 12 日 · 凤凰传奇「吉祥如意」

paragraphs.zh: 进场后，舞台上已经亮着「吉祥如意」几个大字。我在观众席前拍了单人照，也把两个人和身后的舞台一起放进镜头。开场前的照片里，荧光棒还是浅浅的粉白色；等灯光亮起来，整个画面都变了。
paragraphs.en: Once inside, the words Jixiang Ruyi were already glowing onstage. I took a solo photo in front of the audience seating, then put both of us and the stage into the frame. In the pre-show photos, the glow sticks were still a pale pinkish white. When the lights came on, the whole picture changed.

subtitle.zh: 4 月 12 日 · 舞台与看台之间
subtitle.en: 12 April · Between the stage and the stands

paragraphs.zh: 这一晚拍了很多舞台：铺开的光束、金色的圆形图案、红蓝交替的大屏，还有观众席里一层层举起的荧光棒。镜头有时对着台上，有时转向看台，也有几次回过来，给我们自己再拍一张。
paragraphs.en: I took many photos of the stage that evening: spreading beams, golden circular patterns, screens shifting between red and blue, and rows of glow sticks held up in the audience. Sometimes the lens faced the stage, sometimes the stands, and a few times it turned back toward us for another photo.

paragraphs.en: One photo was not a close-up of the stage, but of my watch. It had displayed a loud-environment alert saying the sound had reached 90 decibels. I photographed the watch with the red lights behind it: one very specific little detail from the evening.

subtitle.zh: 4 月 12 日 · 灯光、合影与后来喜欢的歌
subtitle.en: 12 April · Lights, photos together and songs that stayed with me

paragraphs.zh: 台上的画面从红色换到蓝色，看台也跟着变成另一片颜色。把演出的照片留在手记里，我想保留的不只是大屏幕上的人，也包括我们坐在台下的视角：前排的人影、伸到镜头里的荧光棒，以及中途补拍的合影。
paragraphs.en: The stage shifted from red to blue, and the stands changed color with it. Keeping these concert photos in the journal, I wanted more than the people on the big screens. I also wanted our view from below: silhouettes in the rows ahead, glow sticks reaching into the frame, and the photos of us taken along the way.

paragraphs.zh: 这场演唱会之后，我很喜欢《绿旋风》和《光芒》。再回看这一晚，除了满场的灯光，也想把这两个歌名留在手记里：它们是这场演出之后，真正留给我的一部分。
paragraphs.en: After this concert, I really liked “Lü Xuanfeng” (绿旋风) and “Guang Mang” (光芒). Looking back on that evening, I wanted to keep those two song titles here alongside all the lights. They were part of what stayed with me after the show.

title.en: From the stage to the grill

subtitle.zh: 4 月 12 日 · 散场后的夜宵
subtitle.en: 12 April · A late meal after the concert

paragraphs.zh: 我记得，散场后应该是去了西塔老太太吃烤肉。十点多拍下的桌面上摆着肉片和一碗拌好的主食，下一张就是肉放上烤网的样子。舞台的灯光退场后，这一天的最后一组近景，换成了桌上的夜宵。
paragraphs.en: As I recall, we probably went to Xita Laotaitai for barbecue after the concert. In the table photo taken after ten, there were slices of meat and a bowl of mixed food; the next photo showed the meat on the grill. After the stage lights, the day's last close-ups were of our late-night meal.

paragraphs.zh: 再往后，照片回到了酒店的公共区域。第一天就在这些很日常的画面里收了尾。
paragraphs.en: Later photos returned to the hotel's public areas. The first day ended with these very ordinary scenes.

paragraphs.zh: 第二天再拍窗外，天已经蓝了。同一片楼群和绿地，和前一天下午的灰天形成了对照。中午吃饭，桌上是一大碗汤面和一盘肉片；吃过午饭，行程从台州市区转向了天台。
paragraphs.en: When I photographed the view again the next day, the sky was blue. The same buildings and green space looked different from the grey afternoon before. At lunch, the table held a large bowl of noodle soup and a plate of sliced meat. Afterward, the trip moved from urban Taizhou toward Tiantai.

subtitle.zh: 4 月 13 日 · 国清寺一带

paragraphs.zh: 下午来到国清寺一带，先进入镜头的不是殿堂，而是山脚下的田地。绿色一层层铺开，远处的塔立在山前。我们在栏杆边拍了合影，也分别站在同一片田野前留了单人照。
paragraphs.en: Around Guoqing Temple that afternoon, the fields at the foot of the hills reached the camera before the temple halls did. Layers of green spread out, with a distant pagoda standing before the hills. We took a photo together by the railing, then individual portraits in front of the same fields.

paragraphs.zh: 路上还拍下了石牌坊和树下的碑廊。牌坊把天光和远处的绿色框在一起，碑廊前的石灯则落在斑驳树影里。
paragraphs.en: Along the way, I also photographed a stone archway and a stele corridor beneath the trees. The arch framed the sky and distant green, while the stone lantern before the corridor sat in dappled shade.

title.en: From the fields into the shade

subtitle.zh: 4 月 13 日 · 溪水与黄墙

paragraphs.zh: 沿着田边和溪边往里走，树影越来越密。田旁的水顺着石岸流过，再往里的溪面上，红绿相间的枝叶盖住了一部分天空。从开阔田野到树荫下，这一段路本身也值得多留几张照片。
paragraphs.en: Walking inward along the fields and stream, the shade grew denser. Water ran beside stone banks, and farther in, red and green branches covered part of the sky above the stream. From open fields to shade, this stretch of the walk deserved a few more photos of its own.

title.en: Spring light within the yellow walls

subtitle.zh: 4 月 13 日 · 国清寺庭院

paragraphs.zh: 寺里的照片，大多拍得很近：斜伸的树干、屋檐下的阴影、黄墙上的圆门，以及枝叶间的一点花。阳光照到的地方很亮，门洞和树荫里又是另一种深浅。
paragraphs.en: Most of my photos inside the temple were close views: leaning trunks, shadows beneath the eaves, circular doors in yellow walls, and a few flowers among leaves. Where the sun reached, everything was bright; doorways and tree shade held different depths of shadow.

paragraphs.zh: 院子里有高高的树，也有香炉前升起的烟。把大树与殿堂一起拍进去，再把镜头靠近香炉，才看清炉身上的纹样和后方深色的木门。
paragraphs.en: There were tall trees in the courtyards and smoke rising by the incense burner. I first included the trees and halls together, then moved the camera closer to see the burner's patterns and the dark wooden doors behind it.

paragraphs.zh: 靠墙的树干盘曲向上，另一处石门上方又横过一片树冠。阳光从缝隙落下来，黄墙和台阶时明时暗；这些细节放在一起，才更像当时一路走过的国清寺。
paragraphs.en: A trunk twisted upward beside a wall; elsewhere a tree canopy stretched over a stone doorway. Sunlight fell through gaps, leaving yellow walls and steps alternately bright and shaded. Together, these details felt more like the Guoqing Temple we had walked through.

title.en: Inside and outside, part of the same walk

subtitle.zh: 4 月 13 日 · 木廊、溪水与回望
subtitle.en: 13 April · Wooden corridors, water and a look back

paragraphs.zh: 我还拍了廊下悬着的鱼形木器。再往前，院子里铺开了晾晒架，旁边就是木廊和盆栽。一路看过去，留下来的不只是寺院的门面，还有这些细小的日常场景。
paragraphs.en: I also photographed the fish-shaped wooden object hanging beneath a corridor. Farther on, drying racks spread across a courtyard beside a wooden gallery and potted plants. What I kept was not only the temple's formal face, but these small everyday scenes.

paragraphs.zh: 出来后，镜头又回到溪水、田边的小路和塔。国清寺这一段，寺里与寺外是连在一起的：黄墙之后还有树，树后还有田地，不必急着把它们分开。
paragraphs.en: Outside again, the lens returned to the stream, the field-side paths and the pagoda. This part of Guoqing Temple joined indoors and outdoors: beyond the yellow walls were trees, and beyond the trees were fields. There was no need to hurry to separate them.

title.en: What stayed with these two days

subtitle.zh: 一晚的灯海，一下午的春光
subtitle.en: An evening of lights, an afternoon of spring

paragraphs.zh: 这趟是为演唱会来的，回头整理时，却很难只留下舞台。健身房里的合影、夜里的烤盘、国清寺前同一个栏杆边的两张单人照，还有咖啡窗口旁的镜子，都把这次台州接成了完整一些的两天。
paragraphs.en: I came for the concert, but looking back, it was hard to keep only the stage. The photo together in the gym, the grill at night, two solo portraits at the same railing outside Guoqing Temple, and the mirror beside the coffee window made these two days in Taizhou feel more complete.

paragraphs.zh: 一晚的灯海，接着一下午的春光。这就是这趟旅行目前留在照片里的样子。
paragraphs.en: An evening of stage lights, followed by an afternoon of spring. That is how this trip lives in the photos for now.
